title: Online home valuation tool · HousySpace
description: Find out instantly how much your home is worth in Barcelona with the online valuation tool and, if you wish, request a personalised valuation from an advisor.

head.heading: The value of your home *deserves more than a figure*

items.text: Every home is different, and so is its value. We study its features, its location and market conditions to give you a well-founded valuation and help you make decisions with confidence.
Two ways to get a valuation
Choose how to find out *what your home is worth*
You can start with an online estimate and, whenever you like, ask an advisor to look at your home. The two steps complement each other.
A first indicative estimate based on the details you enter. Useful as an initial reference, but it does not replace an individual assessment of the property.
Based on the details you enter
We look at your home, its specific features and market conditions, and explain what drives its value.

items.label: Request a valuation with an advisor

items.text: Can't see the valuation tool? [Open it in a new tab](https://valuation.lystos.com?clientId=0cf1b7eb-0479-481f-9d1d-61a1697d5b31).

The valuation tool estimate is indicative; it is not an official appraisal. The tool is provided by an external supplier, Lystos: data you enter will be processed according to their privacy information and that of HousySpace
Leave us your details and a HousySpace advisor will call you to value your home in person.

fields.name: consent
fields.label: I have read the privacy information and consent to HousySpace processing this data to handle my request.

fields.name: mkt
fields.label: I would like to receive commercial communications from HousySpace about properties, services and news by email, WhatsApp or phone. (Optional.)

fields.name: news
fields.label: I would like to subscribe to the HousySpace newsletter and articles by email. (Optional.)

fields.text: Controller: HousySpace Consultores Inmobiliarios, S.L. Purpose: handling your request and, only if you tick the boxes, sending commercial communications and the newsletter. Legal basis: your consent. Recipients: we do not share your data, except where legally required. Rights: access, rectification, erasure, objection, restriction, portability and withdrawal of consent at [info@housyspace.com](mailto:info@housyspace.com); you may lodge a complaint with the AEPD. More information in the [privacy policy](route:privacy). (Legal text draft.)
No system is yet in place to receive the form (CRM pending). Clicking will open WhatsApp with your request pre-filled for you to send; until you send it there, it will not have reached HousySpace.
